result.headline: Human Written
result.prediction: We believe that this entire text is human-written.
result.text: I keep reparenting and meditating when I'm in love too. That's exactly when it's easy to stop, because somebody else is making me feel good. If I only remember how to regulate myself after the relationship is in trouble, I waited too long.
